status.comment: existing text-patch-v2 only; measured compatibility candidate

p.ARTIFACT-CODEC: The internal codec contract identifies targets, plans/applies/extracts, fingerprints deterministic artifact bytes, reports operations and inventory metadata, and declares discipline compatibility. The installed seam registers only text-patch-v2, preserving strict v2 parsing, lossless serialization, normalized regeneration and exact unified application. Unknown codecs/profiles refuse before writes. This codec advertises add/modify only; delete/move/replace remain vocabulary, not invented capability. File existence is explicit, and target/base/output digests bind a plan; changed base or plan output refuses. Known failures are typed results; programmer failures are not silently collapsed. No new persisted codec field, binary/delete implementation, ABI widening or changed delta/history domain is introduced. CLI and engines consume library capabilities rather than duplicate codec behavior.

p.PATH-MIGRATION-DESIGN: Legacy text-patch-v2 retains the / to __ filename mapping and its existing refusal for __ in a target. Do not broaden its reader or rename artifacts silently. A future representation must carry explicit target/operation data with safe artifact IDs or a uniquely reversible filename encoding, bind payload and target checksums and version its dispatch. Compatibility cases must cover spaces, quotes and __, rename conflicts and unsupported versions before writes. Migration is explicit: inspect and validate the old repository, construct a complete collision-free target manifest, preview old/new digests, then write under checkout custody with compare barriers. A migration failure keeps original bytes; no rollback of external delivery is implied. Implementation awaits a measured consumer need and is not part of this v2 seam.
